welcome_subtitle: A creative sanctuary focusing on craftsmanship, cosplay, and community.
about_teaser_p1: Cosplay for All (CfA) is a community passionate about cosplay and craftsmanship. We are a member-based organization for cosplay enthusiasts at all skill levels.
about_teaser_p2: Whether you work with sewing, prop-making, 3D printing, or EVA foam, we gather to learn, build, and create amazing costumes together!
events_section_desc: Here you will find an overview of upcoming cosplay conventions and events.
gallery_teaser_desc: Photos and creations from our wonderful members.
join_community_desc: We welcome all cosplayers – whether you are a beginner or an experienced maker.
about_page_subtitle: We celebrate creativity, costume design, and community.
vision_p1: Cosplay for All (CfA) is a registered non-profit volunteer organization working to make cosplay and creativity accessible to everyone, regardless of prior knowledge, ability, or experience level. We share knowledge, tools, and equipment, and support each other throughout the entire creative process from concept to finished creation.
vision_p2: Our goal is to promote craftsmanship, community, and a safe, inclusive environment for creative minds. We organize regular meetups, workshops, and group trips to conventions across the country.
